parts: How to perform simulations for a Likert scale order data 5 for a multi-group model?

See the ?simulateData help page for a single-group example and normal data.  I adapted that example below (using just 1 factor, so a CFA with 3 indicators) in two ways:
  • to make it for multiple groups by supplying vectors of parameters (1 per group) and passing a vector of sample sizes to the sample.nobs= argument
  • I added 4 thresholds for variables x1-x3 to make them categorical. 
That shows you the basic functionality, and you can generalize from there to your own goals.

population.model <- ' f1 =~ c(.7, .7)*x1 + c(0.8, 0.8)*x2 + c(0.7, 0.8)*x3
## factor variance
  f1 ~~ c(1, 1)*f1
## residual variances (such that indicator total variances == 1)
  x1 ~~ c(.51, .51)*x1
  x2 ~~ c(.36, .36)*x2
  x3 ~~ c(.51, .36)*x3
## thresholds
  x1 | -1.5*t1 + -0.5*t2 + 0.5*t3 + 1.5*t4
  x2 | -2*t1 + -1*t2 + 0*t3 + 1*t4
  x3 | -1*t1 + 0*t2 + 1*t3 + 2*t4
'
## generate data
set.seed(1234)
myData <- simulateData(population.model, sample.nobs = c(100L, 100L),
                       parameterization = "theta")
## quick check
opar <- par(mfrow = c(3, 1))
for (i in 1:3) hist(myData[ , paste0("x", i)])
par(opar)

parts:
Is it possible to control the shape of the distribution through the thresholds for each group, for example? Normal or non normal distribution 
(1) a symmetric distribution, (2) a slightly asymmetric distribution, 
(3) a moderately asymmetric distribution, and (4) a bipolarized distribution. When responding to Likert-type items
Yes, that is what my script illustrated by using different thresholds across indicators (see the histograms I produced at the end).
I had the following error

Error in parse(text = x, keep.source = FALSE) : 
  <text>:1:3: unexpected '<'
1: ~ <
      ^

I'm not sure why parse() was indicating you had a "<" character in your syntax, but the real problem is that you used an actual minus sign character instead of a simple hyphen in your syntax.  

"−" == "-" # false

Your syntax runs fine when you use hyphens:

population.model <- ' f1 =~ c(.7, .7)*x1 + c(0.8, 0.8)*x2 + c(0.7, 0.8)*x3
## factor variance
  f1 ~~ c(1, 1)*f1
## residual variances (such that indicator total variances == 1)
  x1 ~~ c(.51, .51)*x1
  x2 ~~ c(.36, .36)*x2
  x3 ~~ c(.51, .36)*x3
## thresholds

x1 | -1.282*t1 + -0.524*t2 + 0.524*t3 + 1.282*t4
  x2 | -1.282*t1 + -0.524*t2 + 0.524*t3 + 1.282*t4
  x3 | -1.282*t1 + -0.524*t2 + 0.524*t3 + 1.282*t4
'

set.seed(1234)
myData <- simulateData(population.model, sample.nobs = c(100L, 100L),
                       parameterization = "theta")

FYI, it is easier for us to copy/paste your syntax when you just provide the syntax.  Don't copy it from the Console output, because then we have to erase all the plus signs in the left margin.  Only copy the relevant output from the Console (e.g., error or warning message).
